# Inspire Advocacy

> Inspire Advocacy is the criminal law practice of Advocate Rupesh Kumar Thakur, an advocate in Motihari practising at the Civil Court, Motihari, East Champaran district, Bihar, India.

- Advocate: Rupesh Kumar Thakur, B.Sc., LL.B.
- Enrolment: Bar Council of Bihar, BR/3241A/2013 (enrolled 2013)
- Bar association: Member, Motihari Bar Association
- Practice: criminal law (bail and anticipatory bail, criminal trials, Bihar Prohibition and Excise Act cases, NDPS and other special statutes, cyber crime, dowry and matrimonial offences, cheque bounce, vehicle and property release, revisions and appeals)
- Court: Civil Court, Motihari (District & Sessions Court, CJM court and special courts of East Champaran)
- Chamber: Gali No. 5, near Palita Singh Hotel, Sri Krishna Nagar, Motihari, Bihar 845401
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 94708 62425
- Email: inspireadvocacy@gmail.com
- Chamber hours: 10:30 AM to 5:00 PM, consultations by prior appointment
- Languages: Hindi, Bhojpuri, English

This website is informational and follows Rule 36 of the Bar Council of India Rules. It does not advertise, solicit work or claim results.
